lines: The perimeter lighthouse looms ahead, its beacon guttering against the encroaching dark.
Siege Warden Kael's voice crackles over the field relay: 'Defenders in position. Lighthouse integrity at full. First wave incoming — hold the line.'
Use the REPAIR button between waves to restore the lighthouse with silicon. If the beacon falls, the darkness wins.
The last wave breaks against your defense. The lighthouse beacon blazes to full intensity, pushing the darkness back beyond the perimeter.
Siege Warden Kael: 'Ten waves. You held through all ten. The beacon's burning brighter than it has in months.'
Siege Warden Kael: 'Take what the darkness dropped — you've earned it. Use the portal when you're ready to return.'
The lighthouse beacon sputters and dies. Darkness floods the perimeter as the defensive grid collapses.
Siege Warden Kael: 'Pull back! The lighthouse is gone. We'll have to rebuild before we can try again.'
A return portal shimmers open. Regroup and come back stronger.
